base_rationale: Base 72 achieved highest primary hits (57/117, 48.72%), broken 52 plateau. Primary objective is to fix non-one-price shortfall (46 < 48) by pruning fading-theme false positives and picking intra-theme true early sealers.

fields_definition.name_anchor_broken_age_sessions: Minimum trading sessions since anchor broke limit in [p-3, p-1] window. 0=still limit yesterday; 1=broke yesterday; 2=broke 2 days ago; NaN=no anchor in window.
fields_definition.name_anchor_decay_from_peak: Historical peak height of matched anchor up to p-1 minus height at p-1 (0 if non-limit at p-1). Measures theme exhaustion level.
fields_definition.name_fixed_followers_return_acceleration: Mean return on day S minus mean return on day S-1 for the fixed cohort of followers (height 1 or 2 at p-1). Measures slope of follower profit sentiment.
fields_definition.theme_candidate_cohort_size: Number of first-board candidates on day S matching the same active anchor token. Measures intra-theme candidate crowd size.
fields_definition.theme_first_seal_rank_in_group: Normalized rank (0.0 to 1.0) of reported_first_seal_trading_minutes within same-token candidate cohort on day S when size >= 2, else NaN.
fields_definition.theme_is_earliest_sealer: Binary 1.0 if candidate is earliest first-seal in same-token cohort on day S, 0.0 otherwise. 1.0 if size == 1, NaN if no anchor.
fields_definition.theme_close_seal_rank_in_group: Normalized rank (0.0 to 1.0) of reported_close_seal_log_amount_ratio (descending) within same-token candidate cohort on day S when size >= 2, else NaN.

fixed_evaluation_criteria.production_goal_60: >= 60% full date hit rate, >= 200 known, outcome coverage >= 95%, 0 abstentions, both 2025H2 and 2026 >= 55%
